environment.description: Same Terraform provider OAuth callback service deployed on ECS Fargate behind internal ALB. The OAUTH_REDIRECT_VALIDATION_MODE environment variable is managed exclusively through a Split.io feature flag evaluation performed at container initialization via the split-synchronizer sidecar (SDK key scoped to 'oauth-provider-prod' environment). The flag 'oauth_legacy_redirect_compat' is configured with a kill switch that resolves to 'off' treatment for all traffic segments since 2024-01-15, which causes the entrypoint script to set OAUTH_REDIRECT_VALIDATION_MODE=strict (the default non-permissive path). The Split targeting rule has a dependency on the 'infrastructure_migration_complete' flag also being 'on', creating a compound evaluation. Flag changes require approval from two principals in the Split admin group and trigger a PagerDuty incident on modification. The sidecar polls every 5 seconds and the entrypoint re-evaluates on SIGHUP.
